# cockroach_metric_export_otlp_config (Resource)

OTLP metric export configuration for a dedicated cluster. Currently supports exporting to Amazon CloudWatch using SigV4 authentication. The Cloud API marks this feature as limited access; the organization and cluster must have access to OTLP metric export.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "cluster_id" {
  description = "ID of the cluster whose metrics will be exported."
  type        = string
  nullable    = false
}

variable "role_arn" {
  description = "IAM role that trusts Cockroach Cloud and grants cloudwatch:PutMetricData."
  type        = string
  nullable    = false
}

variable "target_region" {
  description = "AWS region supporting CloudWatch OTLP ingestion and PromQL. Omit to use each cluster deployment region."
  type        = string
  default     = null
}

variable "external_id" {
  description = "External ID required by the IAM role's trust policy, if any."
  type        = string
  default     = null
}

# Requires access to the limited-access OTLP metric export API.
resource "cockroach_metric_export_otlp_config" "example" {
  id = var.cluster_id
  cloudwatch = {
    role_arn      = var.role_arn
    target_region = var.target_region
    external_id   = var.external_id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloudwatch` (Attributes) Amazon CloudWatch destination for OTLP metrics. This uses the CloudWatch OTLP ingestion API, separately from the existing CloudWatch metric export resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloudwatch))
- `id` (String) Cluster ID. Changing this value replaces the export configuration.

### Read-Only

- `status` (String) Export deployment status: [`NOT_DEPLOYED` `DISABLING` `ENABLING` `ENABLED` `ERROR`]. Create and update wait for `ENABLED`.
- `user_message` (String) Human-readable description of the export status, including hints for resolving errors.

<a id="nestedatt--cloudwatch"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloudwatch`

Required:

- `role_arn` (String) The IAM role assumed to send metrics via SigV4. The role must trust Cockroach Cloud and grant `cloudwatch:PutMetricData`.

Optional:

- `external_id` (String) External ID included when assuming the IAM role. Set this if required by the role's trust policy.
- `target_region` (String) AWS region to export metrics to. It must support CloudWatch OTLP ingestion and PromQL. When omitted, metrics are exported to each cluster deployment region.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import an existing OTLP metric export configuration using its cluster ID.
terraform import cockroach_metric_export_otlp_config.example 1f69fdd2-600a-4cfc-a9ba-16995df0d77d
```
